## Description {#details}

<p>An abstract interface for potential values analysis.</p>


<p>This <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/aa">AA</a> collects potential values for each IR position. An assumed set of potential values is initialized with the empty set (the best state) and it will grow monotonically as we find more potential values for this position. The set might be forced to the worst state, that is, to contain every possible value for this position in 2 cases.</p>


<ol class="doxyList" type="1">
<li>We surpassed the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">MaxPotentialValues</span> threshold. This includes the case that this position is affected (e.g. because of an operation) by a <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/value">Value</a> that is in the worst state.</li>
<li>We tried to initialize on a <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/value">Value</a> that we cannot handle (e.g. an operator we do not currently handle).</li>
</ol>

<p>For non constant integers see <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/aapotentialvalues">AAPotentialValues</a>.</p>


<p>Definition at line 5252 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/transforms/include/llvm/transforms/ipo/attributor-h">Attributor.h</a>.</p>
